quests.title: Origin of the Sequence

dialogue.t: Vital signs detected. Invoking identification sequence: <color=#FF5E41FF>ERROR</color>. Commencing kernel security check...
Kernel security check: <color=#FF5E41FF>FAILED</color>. Central module damaged or missing. Please contact Nin-Kiggia for maintenance. Initiating backup safety mode...
My apologies. The identification sequence is currently unable to verify the visitor. Consequently, I cannot address you by your proper title. Commencing universal greeting playback.
Welcome to the Ia-I{RUBY#[S]No. 59}limmu Storage Array. This array is primarily used to regulate the operation of the Engraving and to store various research resources.

<color=#FF5E41FF>ERROR</color>: Critical component failure has resulted in service dependency anomalies. Main functions are currently unavailable. Please execute a self-diagnostic command to restore critical data nodes.
Oh, Paimon didn't really get what it was saying, but it sounds like we just need to follow the instructions on the screen to fix this thing, right?
And if this place is for "storing resources," that just means it's a "storehouse"! Paimon bets there are all kinds of super-amazing treasures nearby! Come on, let's give it a shot!
Self-diagnostic: Repair complete. Thank you for your help. Deactivating lockdown...
<color=#FF5E41FF>ERROR</color>: Primary energy system not connected. Please contact Nin-Kiggia for assistance, or provide an auxiliary power source.

quests.description: You discover a strangely familiar tower…
